North Cloud

Software Engineer, Frontend

Software Engineer, Frontend

About North Cloud

The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200B annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them.

At North, we're building the next-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances, so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money.

Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global customers like Brave, The New York Public Library, and SumUp, we're assembling a world-class team to redefine how businesses manage cloud infrastructure.

*Please link your github in your application.

About the role

We’re looking for talented engineers who thrive on working on complex problems and solving them through building reliable and easy to use features. You’ll work across the frontend stack, API ingestion, data representations, complex proprietary data visualization, and agentic UI workflows.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll partner with engineers and our CTO to design and implement core systems spanning multiple clouds. If you enjoy solving ambiguous data problems by building the backbone of a modern SaaS platform, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Architect, develop, and maintain user-facing features using SvelteKit, Svelte 5, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS.
Implement scalable, maintainable component structures and frontend architecture.
Build responsive, accessible, and performant interfaces optimized for clarity and consistency.
Collaborate with product and backend engineering to refine specifications, workflows, and API contracts.
Implement robust error handling, boundary states, and loading strategies.
Ensure code quality through reviews, documentation, linting, and testing.
Contribute to frontend performance optimization and observability.
Own features end-to-end, from architecture → implementation → testing → deployment → monitoring.

What we're looking for

3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
Strong proficiency with Svelte, SvelteKit, or equivalent modern frameworks.
Deep expertise in TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and web application architecture.
Advanced proficiency with TailwindCSS for building scalable and consistent UIs.
Strong understanding of interaction patterns, layout systems, accessibility, and responsive UI.
Hands-on experience with modern build tools (Vite, ES modules, bundlers, Bun).
Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit or integration).
Experience developing good UX focused on self-serving applications to encourage product led growth
Experience in a fast-paced and frequent code deployment environment
Excellent communication skills and a disciplined, documentation-first mindset.
Strong technical judgment and ability to make informed tradeoffs in an evolving product environment.

Nice to have

Experience with Playwright for end-to-end testing.
Familiarity with component library architecture or design system engineering.
Experience optimizing frontend performance at scale.
Exposure to complex, data-dense interfaces or enterprise-grade web applications.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).

Work setup

Hybrid role based in New York City, with an office in Dumbo, Brooklyn.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO
16-week fully paid parental leave (20 weeks at 50% for mothers)
Company-wide breaks: last week of August & Dec 23–Jan 3
The opportunity to participate in company benefits, including a Medical PPO Plan with the majority of the premium covered by North
30-day sabbatical every 4 years

The pay range for this role is:

140,000 - 180,000 USD per year (Brooklyn HQ)
